text:
jess: Heads-up — after the mkdocs migration I'm seeing broken anchor links on a few KB pages. Pulled a quick sample list below, can owners take these or assign?

jess: 1) /guides/api/auth.md#token-rotation -> 404 anchor
jess: 2) /runbooks/latency-mitigation.md#cache-priming -> anchor mismatch
jess: 3) /deploy/checklist.md#post-deploy-smoke -> missing anchor

jess: pinging owners I think: @ankur for API guide, @vikram for runbooks, @sam for deploy docs. If anyone else sees related failures please add them.

ankur: I can take the API auth page. Looks like the header changed from "Token rotation" to "Rotating tokens" during the convert. I'll open a tiny redirect/anchor alias PR.

vikram: I'll triage the runbook anchors tomorrow morning — likely the heading level changed so anchors got renamed. If it's a quick 1-line fix I can do it in the runbook repo.

sam: Happy to handle deploy/checklist. Do we prefer adding explicit anchors or adding redirects? I can do either but want to be consistent.

maria: Quick question on priority — are these causing any customer-facing 404s (docs links surfaced in support tickets) or is this internal only?

jess: Good Q. Some were from support tickets (customer links landing on anchor-less pages). Filed a support ticket list in the shared doc: <https://redwoodhq.internal/sd/support-doc-links> — marking 2 as P1.

chris: For folks fixing anchors, you can run the local link-checker:
```
pip install md-linkcheck
md-linkcheck site/ --exclude "*.png" --max-depth 3
```
This will flag anchor mismatches. Saved me a bunch.

ankur: PR opened: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842> — adds alias anchors and a tiny note in the migration guide. @vikram / @sam can you review when you have a minute?

docs-bot: :robot_face: Automated scan found 18 anchor issues in the last 24h. Full log: <https://internal-logs.redwood/anchor-audit/176124>

vikram: Reviewing ankurs PR now. If it's small I'll merge and backfill similar patterns across runbooks with a search/replace.

sam: I'll draft a short PR template for anchor fixes (one-liner changelog + link-check command) so reviewers know to run the checker. Posting draft in 10.

jess: Awesome — thanks everyone. Let's aim to close the P1s by EOD tomorrow and then plan a full anchor audit next week. I'll drop the audit checklist in #docs and assign owners once we confirm scope. :thumbsup:
